# Site check (evening): mychata.cz, 14 Oct 2026

This is the second site check today, run at about 20:00 UTC after PR #33 was merged. The morning report is `2026-10-14-site-check.md`. The check was read-only: nobody signed in, no forms were submitted and no data was changed. The invalid links used made-up tokens, not any cottage's real links.

## Summary

The live site runs `9f801e8` (PR #33, T-029). That is the head of `main`, and the existing tag `release-2026-10-14` points to the same commit.

- 6 of 6 e2e smoke tests pass.
- None of the 5 pages has console errors.
- The seasonal photo now loads from `/assets/`, and all page titles are Czech.
- The cookie banner position was not verified, because the banner does not appear for visitors outside the EU and the check ran from a US address.

## Performance on `/auth` (375px, one cold load)

- **Load timings:** largest element shown (LCP) at 1.64 s, which is the hero photo. CLS 0. INP about 24 ms from one tap on the language toggle, which was already set to CZ.
- **Server response:** the first byte took 1.13 s and is most of the LCP time. The proxy and the US route probably add to it.
- **Biggest resources (transferred):**
  - `chata-autumn-DIt40PoD.webp`: 380 KB
  - `index-BTjrpVd9.js`: 182 KB
  - `favicon.ico`: 20 KB
  - `styles-AtcYftTU.css`: 16 KB

## Smaller findings

- `og:image` and `twitter:image` still point at Lovable's R2 bucket. That affects link previews only, not the page.
- The 380 KB hero photo is large for a 375px screen. A smaller mobile size would speed up the first view.

## E2E output

The DevTools MCP was not available. `bun run e2e` cannot run in this cloud copy because `node_modules` is not installed. The repo's `tests/e2e/public.spec.ts` and `playwright.config.ts` were copied unchanged into a scratch folder, with only the Chromium path changed, and run with `E2E_BASE_URL=https://mychata.cz`:

```
Running 6 tests using 1 worker

  6 passed (16.8s)
```
